karen-devex: Heads up — noticed the SDK GET /events?wait_for=5 returns immediately while the REST curl blocks for ~5s as expected. Happening on node + python SDKs. Repro below, filing here before I open a bug.

nina-sdk: Can you paste the curl + SDK snippet? quick checks first.

karen-devex: curl (works as expected):
```
curl -s -D - 'https://api.redwood.ai/events?wait_for=5' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' 
# returns after ~5s with events or empty body
```

Node SDK (returns immediately):
```
await client.events.list({ wait_for: 5 });
// returns almost instantly with empty array
```

sam-backend: We added the wait_for query param to the events endpoint a while ago. Backend honors it (sleeps up to N seconds). If REST blocks but SDK returns fast, sounds like the SDK might be dropping the param or turning it into an empty value.

nina-sdk: Hmm — our request serializer flattens params and strips entries where value === undefined || value === null || value === '' . If number 0/5 is getting coerced to '' somewhere (or passed as numeric and then lost), that could explain it. Also our retry layer treats empty 200/204 as transient and retries immediately — so you may see rapid empty responses.

ryan-qe: I repro on python too. Passing wait_for as int vs str behaves differently: str("5") -> backend waits, int(5) -> SDK seems to drop it. Looks like a param-typing edge in the SDK. This is causing flaky onboarding e2e tests (they expect longpoll semantics).

karen-devex: Workaround for now: call via REST or send wait_for: '5' (string) in SDK. But that's awful for onboarding docs. New user hit this in sampleapp tutorial.

sam-backend: We should also make server-side resilient: treat missing wait_for as default wait (or return explicit 400?). But SDK still needs to preserve query params.

nina-sdk: I'll open a PR to change the serializer: keep numbers and booleans, only drop undefined/null. Also add unit tests for GET query passthrough and a regression test for longpoll endpoints. Will also add a guard in retry logic so we don't immediately retry on 200 with empty body unless content-type indicates no-content.

karen-devex: Can you tag this with a changelog note? "SDK: preserve numeric query params; fix retry behavior on empty 200s" We should add a short note in Quickstart about types until fix lands.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: branch sdk/query-param-pass-through#142 (CI: pending) :rocket:

nina-sdk: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/142 — includes unit tests + changelog. cc @sam-backend for any server hardening suggestions.

sam-backend: Thx. We'll add a tiny server-side tolerance to not immediately return on missing wait_for for a few days during rollout.

ryan-qe: I'll add an e2e test to sampleapp that uses numeric wait_for and assert the client blocks ~N seconds. That should catch regressions.

karen-devex: Great. Leaving this thread open until PR lands & sampleapp updated. Thanks all :thumbsup:
